import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

data = '''
<person>
   <name>Chuck</name>
   <phone type="intl">
      +1 734 303 4456
   </phone>
   <email hide="yes" />
</person>'''

tree = ET.fromstring(data)
name = tree.find('name').text
ptype = tree.find('phone').get('type')
hide = tree.find('email').get('hide')
print(name)
print(ptype)
print(hide)

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

input_data = '''
<stuff>
   <users>
      <user x="2">
         <id>001</id>
         <name>Chuck</name>
      </user>
      <user x="7">
         <id>009</id>
         <name>Brent</name>
      </user>
   </users>
</stuff>'''

stuff = ET.fromstring(input_data)
lst = stuff.findall('users/user')
print('User count:', len(lst))
names = list()
for item in lst:
    names.append(item.find('name').text)
print(names)

import json

payload_ok = '{"status": "OK", "results": [{"lat": 42.2808, "lng": -83.743, "place_id": "ChIJMx9D1A2wPIgR4rXIhkb5Cds"}]}'
payload_bad = '{"status": "error", "results": []}'

for payload in [payload_ok, payload_bad]:
    js = json.loads(payload)
    place = None
    if js['status'] == 'OK':  # حالة الأحرف كما تتهجى الخدمة / letter case as the service spells it
        place = js['results'][0]
    if place is None:
        print('status: error')
    else:
        print('lat: %s' % place['lat'])
